text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the NHK Mile C. nearly here, Agnes Tachyon is once again diligently gathering data on the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm still pondering how Agnes Tachyon's running has changed, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She insists that I only worry about today's results and exits the waiting room without offering any explanation.
